response.justification: The candidate is an experienced generalist/full-stack engineer with strong web, Node.js/TypeScript, and DLang background, but the role's mandatory requirements are largely unmet. C++ exposure is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (plus a university thesis project), which falls far short of 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle experience, no fixed income or fixed income derivatives work, and no investment banking or capital markets systems development (RIDE Capital was a Node/GraphQL fintech product, not a capital-markets trading platform). While communication skills and engineering practices are clearly strong, the gap on core technical and domain criteria is too large for this specific mandate.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured engineering career with strong software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and course authoring
Some low-latency/high-throughput systems experience (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++, over a decade ago; no Windows C++ depth
No SQL Server/Oracle experience; SQL listed generically with MongoDB/MySQL focus
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking/capital markets domain exposure
